Net.Amount — Confidence: Very high (~95%)

Vat.Amount — Confidence: Very high (~95%)

Vat.Rate — Confidence: Very high (~95%)

- Consistency: Matches Net and VAT amount.

Sender.VatId — Confidence: Medium (~60%)

  - "USt-Id: ATU22642807" near customer-number block.
  - "USt-IdNr. ATU14391601" in footer with STAMAG company/contact details.
- Ambiguity: Which one is the sender's VAT ID? The footer VAT (ATU14391601) is tied to the company STAMAG (seller), suggesting it is the sender VAT; the header VAT (ATU22642807) may belong to the customer or another entity.
- Risk: Without explicit label linking each VAT number to "Sender" vs "Customer", choice is uncertain.
